Cluster.//Provision: false = connect to a stack already running (docker-cache-test/up.ps1), which keeps the local edit-and-rerun loop fast. true = the fixture provisions SQL + Redis + the API instances itself via Testcontainers, so `dotnet test` needs nothing but Docker. Override with SHA_Cluster__Provision=true.
Cluster.//BaseUrls: Used in external mode only. In managed mode the fixture overwrites these with the randomly mapped container ports.
Cluster.//TestSetting: An int setting owned by the functional-test module, so mutating it cannot affect framework behaviour. Cache key is <Module>.<Name>.
Cluster.//TestApiTarget: Deliberately a functional-test endpoint. Framework services inherit app:Configurator from their parent, so a failed restore there would leave real APIs locked down.
